deals.title: Canadian Meal Deal
deals.description: A quarter-pound beef burger, Canadian fries, a Frosty and a drink. Ask for the Canadian Meal Deal.
deals.terms: Limited offer through November 15, 2026 at participating Canadian Wendy’s. Request the $8.99 Canadian Meal Deal. Upsizing and taxes extra.

deals.description: Choose a McDouble, Junior Chicken or Chicken Snack Wrap meal with small fries and a small drink.
deals.terms: 2026 one-year price promise announced January 13. Breakfast until 11 a.m. Prices before tax; not available through delivery. Product availability varies by restaurant. Confirm at your local branch.
